To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

for the models with nonminimal coupling the global qualitative analysis can be performed in the same way as for models with minimally coupled scalar fields and that for the models including nonminimally and minimally coupled scalar terms the dynamics is determined by a combination of the nonminimal and the minimal terms.
the nonminimal coupling to gravity can lead to the inflationary regime and to a late-time acceleration of the universe, but it is unable to produce the de Sitter-like inflationary regime.

the global dynamics of cosmological model with a nonminimal scalar field can be classified into four qualitatively different classes, which are determined by the values of the power index $N$ and the power index $n$ of the scalar field potential.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the global stability analysis for cosmologies with a nonminimal coupling between the scalar field and gravity.
the global qualitative analysis of dynamics of cosmological scalar-field models with a nonminimal coupling to gravity, which is of interest for cosmology and quantum gravity.
the global stability analysis for a broad class of models with nonminimal coupling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the nonminimally interacting scalar field with a monomial potential is a rich and flexible tool for cosmological modelling, which allows us to reproduce a wide variety of cosmological dynamics, including the early inflationary epoch and the late-time accelerated expansion.
the nonminimal coupling of the scalar field to gravity does not lead to any new types of asymptotic behavior in comparison with the minimal model.
the dynamics is very rich and complicated and the global stability analysis is a necessary step to understand the cosmological consequences of these models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nonminimal coupling to gravity is a strong factor which can lead to a very rich dynamics.
the global stability analysis of the models with the nonminimally-coupled scalar field is a nontrivial task.

the global qualitative analysis allows to identify the main features of cosmological dynamics in the considered models, and to cover the main cases of small $n$ and $N$ by a limiting amount of phase-space diagrams.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nonminimally coupling can significantly change the global dynamics of the scalar field, which is not always obvious from local considerations of a particular case.
the global stability analysis is a very useful tool to understand the dynamics in a wide class of models.
the global stability of the cosmological solutions is not guaranteed in general and depends on the specific form of the nonminimal coupling and the potential.
